Single-Page Application

Redux Toolkit / RTK Query, Tailwind 4]
Runs in the browser. Public pages and
role-specific dashboards. Source: Client/

REST API
[Container: Node.js, Express 5, Mongoose,
JWT, multer, Nodemailer]
Authentication, authorization, business rules,
validation, uploads. PORT default 5000,
base path /api/v1. Source: Server/
